s01.subheadingBodyCopy: Our Riyadh-based technical team works on site across the Kingdom, running live unit allocation, failover systems and VIP presentations at property exhibitions, developer offices and flagship sales centers.

s02.h2: Kingdom-Wide Launch Support From a Riyadh-Based Team
s02.subheadingBodyCopy: On launch day, most VIP demand arrives within a few hours. Manzili puts command engineers on site across your sales footprint to keep systems running, manage allocation surges and support high-value negotiations.
s02.block01Body: Turnkey on-site setup at Cityscape Global in Riyadh, RestateX Riyadh, RestateX Jeddah and Cityscape Jeddah. We stage LED walls, touch table networks, private VIP negotiation suites and dedicated networks inside crowded exhibition halls.
block01Features: No reliance on public event Wi-Fi
s02.block02Body: On-site technical management in your boardrooms, offices and flagship sales galleries. Our specialists work alongside your commercial team, keeping touch tables running and headquarters suites in sync with regional sales floors.
s02.block03Body: A dedicated war room monitors unit allocation, Sub-500 ms inventory sync and floor traffic in real time. With hot-standby rigs and dual-carrier cellular backup, the team fixes technical issues before they reach the negotiation table.

s03.h2: How On-Site Launch Command Protects Your Sales
s03.card01Body: Redundant hardware and dedicated on-site technicians keep screens, touch tables and reservation systems running through the event.
s03.card02Body: The platform handles simultaneous VIP reservations, placing timed unit holds so units aren't double-booked across exhibition booths and remote channels.
s03.card03Chip: 2-hour dispatch on launch days · 4-hour standard support SLA
s03.card03Body: Our Riyadh-based specialists reach Riyadh venues within 2 hours on launch days and deploy Kingdom-wide to Jeddah, Khobar, Makkah and Madinah.

s04.subheadingBodyCopy: Our Riyadh team coordinates logistics, hardware staging and war room monitoring at every major real estate venue in the Kingdom.
row1: Multi-touch tables, fine-pitch LED stages, isolated Wi-Fi
row2: Touch tables, local GPU workstations, live CRM link
row3: Rec.709 OLED displays, low-latency co-browsing rigs
row4: Rapid-deploy presentation stages, LTE/5G dual uplinks

s05.q1: Where is the Manzili launch team based?
s05.a1: In Riyadh. Our bilingual Saudi engineers and field technicians work on site at your venue and deploy Kingdom-wide, covering Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah, Madinah and the Eastern Province.
s05.q2: Which real estate exhibitions does Manzili support in KSA?
s05.a2: The major ones, including Cityscape Global at the Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Center, RestateX Riyadh, RestateX Jeddah and Cityscape Jeddah, as well as private developer launch events.
s05.q3: How do you protect connectivity at crowded exhibitions?
s05.a3: We never rely on public exhibition Wi-Fi. We set up a private local network with dual-bonded 5G uplinks and run the Unreal Engine 5 app offline on local workstations, so presentations and reservations continue even if the hall network goes down.
